subject: Claude CCAF: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output
description: Evaluator-Optimizer patterns, structured failure feedback, bounded retry loops, and golden evaluation datasets.

questions.question: Claude generates a response, a separate validation step checks it against business rules, failures are fed back for correction, and this repeats until validation passes or a maximum attempt count is reached. What is this pattern called?
questions.source: UD4-033 | Building effective agents — evaluator-optimizer · Structured outputs
questions.explanation: The validation-retry loop combines deterministic verification against business rules with structured error feedback fed back to the generator over a bounded attempt budget.
questions.examTrick: Generate -> Validate -> Feed error back -> Retry = Validation-Retry Loop.

questions.question: A validation-retry loop still fails on the same documents after three attempts each. In which situations will further retries not help?
options: The model placed a correct value in the wrong field on the last attempt.
The required information is simply absent from the source document (or exists only in an external unprovided document).
The validation service timed out on the last attempt.
The prompt format had minor whitespace variations.
questions.answer: The required information is simply absent from the source document (or exists only in an external unprovided document).
questions.source: UD4-049 | Building effective agents · Structured outputs
questions.explanation: Retries cannot recover information that does not exist in context. Retrying missing data causes loops to hit max attempts or hallucinate values.
questions.examTrick: Retries fail when required data is absent from input context.
